title: Teacher Workload, Wellbeing, and Retention
discussion_signal: The post distinguishes a modest decline in reported stress from a sustainable workday, emphasizing evenings, weekends, protected planning time, and system-level workload design. It rejects treating individual planning skills as a substitute for institutional capacity.
linked_research_question: When public-school workers absorb work outside paid hours, which institutional changes—not individual efficiency tactics—can protect wellbeing and retention?
limits: Post adds a practitioner framework to RAND findings
The discussion is not representative of teachers
A decline in stress is not proof of sustainable conditions
